d:
Salman Khan. Virat Kohli. Deepika Padukone. Three of India's biggest stars. Three brands that quietly died. Meanwhile Kim Kardashian built a $5 billion empire with the exact same playbook.
So why has India launched 50+ celebrity brands and produced ZERO worth even $100 million?
In this Breakdown, I pull apart the financials of WROGN, Being Human, 82E, Kay Beauty, BeastLife, Underneat and more, then stack them against SKIMS, Fenty and Rare Beauty to find the one missing piece.
You'll learn:
The 2% base rate that fame can't beat
The TR3 framework behind every celebrity brand failure
